{
  "candidate_rtl": "module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
    wire sub_ab = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire sub_ba = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire cin = sub_ab | sub_ba;
    wire [63:0] x = a ^ {64{sub_ba}};
    wire [63:0] y = b ^ {64{sub_ab}};
    wire [63:0] p = x ^ y;
    wire [63:0] g = x & y;
    wire [63:0] arith_sum;

    // Four-bit carry groups, followed by a 16-group prefix network.
    wire [15:0] gp [0:4];
    wire [15:0] gg [0:4];
    wire [15:0] block_cin;

    genvar j, s, k;
    generate
        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin: group_init
            assign gp[0][j] = &p[4*j +: 4];
            assign gg[0][j] = g[4*j+3]
                | (p[4*j+3] & g[4*j+2])
                | (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & g[4*j+1])
                | (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & g[4*j]);
        end
        for (s = 0; s < 4; s = s + 1) begin: prefix_stage
            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin: prefix_node
                if (j >= (1 << s)) begin: combine
                    assign gg[s+1][j] = gg[s][j]
                        | (gp[s][j] & gg[s][j-(1 << s)]);
                    assign gp[s+1][j] = gp[s][j]
                        & gp[s][j-(1 << s)];
                end else begin: pass_through
                    assign gg[s+1][j] = gg[s][j];
                    assign gp[s+1][j] = gp[s][j];
                end
            end
        end
        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin: block_sum
            wire [3:0] c;
            if (j == 0) begin: first_block
                assign block_cin[j] = cin;
            end else begin: later_block
                assign block_cin[j] = gg[4][j-1]
                    | (gp[4][j-1] & cin);
            end
            assign c[0] = block_cin[j];
            for (k = 0; k < 3; k = k + 1) begin: local_carry
                assign c[k+1] = g[4*j+k] | (p[4*j+k] & c[k]);
            end
            assign arith_sum[4*j +: 4] = p[4*j +: 4] ^ c;
        end
    endgenerate

    always @(*) begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = arith_sum;
            3'b001: sum = arith_sum;
            3'b010: sum = arith_sum;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = 64'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": {

This supports investigating arithmetic paths, but no baseline mapped netlist, critical-path report, or arrival-time breakdown was supplied. The baseline area alone does not identify the timing bottleneck, and three source arithmetic expressions do not establish three serial mapped adders."
  },
  "rewrite": "Use one shared arithmetic datapath: a+b, a+(~b)+1, or (~a)+b+1. Compute carries with explicit four-bit group generate/propagate logic and a four-stage parallel-prefix network over the 16 groups. Only three local carry steps remain inside each block. Retain the original bitwise operations and default-zero selection. This is a sparse-prefix compromise intended to limit area relative to a full bit-level prefix network.",
  "expected_timing_gain": {
    "hypothesis": "The explicit group-prefix structure may reduce maximum data arrival if the baseline mapping has a slower carry network or unfavorable arithmetic/output-selection structure. Sharing arithmetic may also reduce output-selection complexity.",
    "limitations": "No numerical timing gain is established. Yosys and ABC may already produce efficient arithmetic, may restructure this network, or may make operand-conditioning and fanout costs dominate. The candidate could be slower. Compare maximum data arrival, not virtual-clock slack, using the specified fixed flow."
  },

    "tradeoff": "Sharing the three arithmetic functions creates an opportunity for area savings, while prefix logic, operand-inversion gates, buffering, and sizing consume area. Prefix connectivity also increases internal fanout. No mapped-area result is available, so compliance with the cap is not established.",
    "required_validation": "This is an unvalidated proposal, not an eligible measured result. Acceptance requires full functional equivalence, mapped area at or below the cap, and zero max-slew and max-capacitance violations under the exact supplied Yosys/ABC/OpenSTA conditions."
  },
  "functional_boundaries": {
    "interface": "Preserves module alu_64bit, 64-bit inputs a and b, 3-bit input Oper, and 64-bit reg output sum.",
    "operation_mapping": {
      "000": "a + b modulo 2^64",
      "001": "a - b modulo 2^64",
      "010": "b - a modulo 2^64",
      "011": "a | b",
      "100": "a & b",
      "101": "a ^ b",
      "110": "a ~^ b",
      "111": "64'b0"
    },
    "arithmetic_identity": "Complementing b and adding one implements a-b; complementing a and adding one implements b-a. Group-prefix carries and local carries implement the same 64-bit addition.",

  }
